answer: Require every agent to emit a signed liveness pulse every few minutes, bound to a single hardware-backed key that can only be in one place at a time. A clone cannot echo the same pulse twice without exposing the duplicate key, and a farm of thousands would need thousands of real devices kept online around the clock. Like water slowly carving karst caves, the cost accumulates invisibly until the attack collapses under its own weight: each identity must keep proving it is alive, alone, and continuously present.
